message:
fix(apk): an activation refused after its generation (unknown entry) becomes the same tap's ordinary connect, once; the AVD harness's host readiness is this run's guarded one or nothing (keepalive-r2 e, Codex avd_guard r1 N1 N3)

N3 (product): Connect starts its worker and the gate returns the generation before the lease's
handshake ends, so the host's "unknown entry" answer arrives later, as the session's Error -- in
tryCommit's establish failure, which had no fallback (Codex probe: gen 1, current 1 -> Error).
StandbyKeep.fallbackAfterEstablishFailure: an activation (pathKind standby), not timed out, whose
lastError is the lease's ACTIVATION_UNKNOWN_ENTRY -> the still-current tap (op + epoch, checked
first) releases the lease and connects ordinarily once, preparedReturn kept. Superseded, cancelled,
busy, a stale tap, an established session's peer_lost: none. The pre-adopt gen-0 path is unchanged.

N1 (test harness): mobile_abr --scenario directoryhost needs --run-id and an --out holding no
readiness; staging or launch failure is INVALID before any window / client; the readiness is
written only after the guard's gate passed, atomically, naming the run, the harness pid, the host
pid and the host's exact log.

Tests: standby_async_fallback_test 13/13 x3 (a real lease + controller against a fake host: Connect
true before the answer, then Error with the exact unknown-entry text; superseded is not it; the
granted control connects). StandbyKeepTest 24/24, the APK's unit tests 314/0; with the decision
forced false (the 57fa793 behaviour) 1 FAIL. The harness without a host: unstageable host, no run
id, a stale readiness -> exit 2, no readiness.
